description: Lists Cosend’s automation recipes as cards, one page at a time: each one’s slug, name, what it does, its category, the settings it asks for and the integrations it needs. Each recipe is set up with a tool of its own named after its slug. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

connection_id.description: Marks the recipes that cannot work on this WhatsApp number.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: list_automation_recipes
title: List automation recipes
